title: Introduction to Disabilities FY27
summary: Introduction for those new to the field of disability services
description: This course is for individuals new to the field of disability services with a special focus on Direct Care Service Providers and Professionals (DSP) and services for individuals who experience intellectual and developmental disabilities (I/DD). This course is intended to provide a wide perspective of basic information about several common types of disabilities. Included are descriptions of some of the challenges individuals experience that are diagnosed with these disabilities remembering that each individual's experience is unique.
